# Vulpkanin
Vulpkanin are a species of canid-like humanoids from the system of Zagua 735, sporting distinct ears and tails. They see the world in reds and greens (though this can be changed with trichromat modifications), and deal [color=#ec3a3a]blunt and slash[/color] with their unarmed attack.
Their fur insulates them mildly from colder temperatures at the cost of making them 15% more vulnterable to taking heat damage. Vulpkanin are also capable of [color=#1e90ff]tracking scents[/color], making them adept at detective work if they so choose to.
